newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ sees NZ$2.87 billion surplus in 1996/97.
newsitem.headline: NZ sees NZ$2.87 billion surplus in 1996/97.

text.p: New Zealand Finance Minister Bill Birch said on Thursday fresh projections showed the government would have a 1996/97 budget surplus of NZ$2.866 billion, 3.1 percent of Gross Domestic Product.
In the budget in May, the forecast was for a NZ$2.758 billion surplus, 2.9 percent of GDP.

In the new projections prepared as part of the pre-election Economic and Fiscal Update, the surplus is projected to rise to NZ$3.388 billion in 1997/98, $4.703 billion in 1998/99 and $6.415 billion in 1999/00, or 5.9 percent of GDP.
